tx: When the contract is completed, an orange message is given in the chatbox, stating that a reward may now be claimed. Players can choose between a combat training book, which provides experience in either Attack, Strength, Defence, Ranged, Magic, Constitution or Necromancy, or a cash reward. The rewards for a special slayer contract depend on the monster killed, and the amount. The table below shows the coins and experience awarded for each monster. For example, a special contract for a Slayer task of 40 abyssal demons rewards either 45,960 coins or 7,716 combat experience. To claim the experience reward, the experience rewarded by the contract cannot exceed 10% of the players total experience in that skill. If it does, players will not be able to use the experience on that skill.
sc: A special slayer contract can be obtained from Erskine in Edgeville while tasked with Slayer assignments that are also possible Slayer contract targets.
To obtain a special slayer contract, the Slayer assignment must be an exact match for the possible contract target.
